status: UPDATED 2026-07-13 -- Unified Champion authority: tradition practice grants T1/T2 at 25/50 points, while the active Champion patron grants exactly one deity-specific Champion boon. Retired broad and generic Champion records remain force-removed save-compatibility records.
notes: Authoritative Breton reward spec for the current 25/50 practice model with a four-point daily cap. Knight's Road, Hidden Art, and Green Way each retain their own T1/T2 practice family. Champion is a patron property: the active eligible Aedric, Y'ffre, or integrated Hidden Art Prince grants exactly one mapped Champion boon, with all other Breton Champion spells removed. PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1, PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T2, the ancestor spine, and PDV_Bless_Breton_PatronChampion remain present only for save compatibility and force-removal. Hidden Art uses WitchcraftExposure as its sole stigma layer; its integrated Prince pact does not add the global Prince price or duplicate stigma. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and no Breton magnitude exceeds the locked budget.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The tradition Survey reports the active PDV_State_BretonTradition spine, KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding bands, PDV_State_BretonDruidicFork, curse posture, and WHY parallel tradition rewards are not all active. Voiced NPC recognition lines are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only: broad Tradition lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + the ONE active tradition's focused family (Layer 2, T1/T2/T3, selected by PDV_State_BretonTradition). The other two focused families are suppressed. The three standing tracks (KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding) MODIFY access/penalty/rupture and are NOT a third buff track; they must not all pay positive rewards at once. Hidden Art is the strongest focused family ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is its price. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Breton ceiling: 'One tradition spine plus one focused patron within it; cross-track pressure modifies or penalizes but adds no extra always-on boon family.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Broad stays softer than every focused family.

authoringPlan.vehicle: Author with a Phase 20 Breton Mutagen helper (mirror tools/pdv-phase20-khajiit-author with an --author-rewards mode reading this spec); one backed-up framework-ESP write. Reuse reward-author patterns (EnsureMagicEffect/ConfigureMagicEffect/EnsureSpell/ConfigureSpell/ParseActorValue). NO night-condition wiring (Breton has no lunar/substrate layer). NO new deity QUSTs.
authoringPlan.recordCreation: Create 16 net-new SPEL with their MGEFs: broad Tradition T1/T2 (2; T1 record fills the EXISTING manager property PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1, T2 is new) + 3 tradition focused families x T1/T2/T3 (9: KnightsRoad/HiddenArt/GreenWay) + 4 creed-loss SPEL (vow-integrity/exposure-rupture/excommunication/druidic-fork-betrayal) + PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Breton (1). Create ZERO deity QUSTs in this baseline: Breton OWNS no Aedric deities (R5), and Phynaster remains blocked until phynasterAcceptanceGate passes. Green Way uses existing Y'ffre; Kynareth is removed from Green Way offer/reward ownership and any former Green Way Kynareth proxy/source/payout item routes to Y'ffre. Daedric forks route through the existing Phase 20C system (R6); create no Daedric records.
authoringPlan.stanceReconcile: For reused deities, add or verify Stance_Breton=0 (NATIVE) only where the deity is actually used by a Breton lane. Green Way uses existing PDV_Deity_Yffre; do not reconcile Kynareth as a Green Way owner.
authoringPlan.noDeityQuestStructureNeeded: Because Breton creates no deity QUSTs, there is no new SGE+SEQ work here. (Reused deities already carry SGE+SEQ from their Imperial-owner authoring run; the BaanDar SGE-omission failure mode does not apply to a pure stance-reconcile.)

baseline.reusedRecords: Breton references existing deity records where needed and creates no new deity QUSTs. Hidden Art references PDV_Deity_Magnus and PDV_Deity_Mara; Green Way references PDV_Deity_Yffre; Kynareth is not a Green Way owner; Phynaster remains proof-gated until a live record/scoring path is accepted.

baseline.stateTracks: PDV_State_BretonTradition (KnightsRoad=0/HiddenArt=1/GreenWay=2) + PDV_State_BretonDruidicFork (None/Druidic/Werewolf/Betrayed) + the three pressure rep-tracks KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding (see PDV_Phase20BretonImplementationCosting.manifest.json).

authoringPlan.wiring: Same run: add or verify Stance_Breton NATIVE on each reused deity QUST actually used by the Breton lanes, including Magnus and Mara for Hidden Art and Y'ffre for Green Way; do NOT add anything to FLST 017E47 (reused deities already present). The broad Tradition T1 fills the existing PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 manager property and is granted via the broad-worship path (PATRON_STATE_BROAD); Tradition T2 is a new broad property. Wire the 9 focused tradition reward props (KnightsRoad/HiddenArt/GreenWay T1/T2/T3) gated on PDV_State_BretonTradition (one active tradition selects the eligible family; suppress the other two) + 4 creed-loss SPEL props + PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Breton. Hidden Art reward props additionally check WitchcraftExposure (magnitude conditioned on exposure cost; rupture revokes). The three standing tracks are wired as access/penalty/rupture modifiers only, never as boon grants.
authoringPlan.verify: housecarl readback (profile Devotion Dev): FLST 017E47 unchanged (no Breton additions); every reused deity QUST actually used by a Breton lane carries Stance_Breton NATIVE; the 16 new SPEL exist with correct MGEF actor-values/magnitudes (no magnitude > ~12%; Hidden Art is the strongest focused family but exposure-gated); broad Tradition T1 fills the existing manager property; manager reward + creed-loss + neglect props resolve; PDV_State_BretonTradition selects exactly one eligible focused family with the other two suppressed; the three standing tracks resolve as pressure modifiers, not boon grants. Then runtime smoke (QASmoke routes 120-124 per the costing manifest).
